text: おまえ　かんけい　ないだろ　かえれよ！

structure.jp: おまえ　かんけい　ないだろ
structure.en: this has nothing to do with you, right?

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a short rough だろう, which pushes the listener to agree: 'right?'. ないだろ = 'there isn't any, right?'.

patterns.name: 〜え (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to an え sound makes a blunt order. かえる becomes かえれ = 'go home!'.
